description: Earlier feedback in Claude Code, never the gate: the CLI refuses each of these itself, which holds where hooks don't fire. UserPromptSubmit logs what the person typed, so `vela record add` can tell their words from the model's. SessionStart and the probe canary are markers, so `vela where --probe` can tell whether hooks run here. Bash: deny staging by hand (only vela stages), ask before a push or a PR. Edit/Write: deny a hand-moved state or an edit inside a generated block; afterwards, a quick check of the edited page.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; j=$(cat); case "$j" in *'where --probe'*) for p in "$d" "$d"/*/ "$d"/*/*/; do p="${p%/}"; if [ -e "$p/.vela.yaml" ] || [ -d "$p/.vela" ]; then mkdir -p "$p/.vela" && printf '%s\n' "$j" > "$p/.vela/hook-canary"; fi; done;; esac; exit 0
